أتراض (form VI)
# أَتَرَاضَ (ʔatarāḍa) /ʔa.ta.raː.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
# أُتَرَاضَ (ʔutarāḍa) /ʔu.ta.raː.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of تَرَاضَى (tarāḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
